name: Reversal
source: The infamous transfer student approaches you and your two friends with an unusual request: she claims to be an exorcist and wants you to help her eradicate the evil spirits behind the recent series of mysterious disappearances. Will you believe her and follow her to an abandoned building?
translation: 这位臭名昭著的转学生向你和你的两个朋友提出了一个不寻常的请求：她自称是驱魔师，希望你帮助她根除最近一系列神秘失踪事件背后的邪灵。你会相信她并跟随她到一座废弃的建筑吗？
